_comment: HRV resting baseline: per-user resting time/frequency-domain norms. Lets stress/recovery apps interpret a live HRV reading relative to the user's own baseline instead of population norms, without a fresh multi-day baselining period.

featureSchemaSpec.notes: Resting norms; a live reading is scored as a z-offset from these. Shorter validUntil reflects faster physiological drift of HRV baselines.
